latin: Ad hoc, quod aliqua scientia alteri non subalternetur, sufficit quod faciat reductionem ad per se nota in suo genere abstractionis.
translation: A science escapes subordination to another provided it can be traced back to self-evident principles within its own genus of abstraction.
translation_note: Farmer calls this the premodern antecedent of Gödel's second theorem (farmer1998:12806). Sense checked against farmer1998:12827.
